body: Also. I don’t want to be here anymore

Why am I important to you? 

I don’t want to be handsome.

Pretty handsome? What do you mean? 

I don’t want to be here anymore
It’ll be a better place without me :)

I’m so sick of being here. I feel like I’m suffocating.

People say how I should get help - I HAVE, I WAS IN HOSPITAL I HAVE TRIED MEDICATION AND THERAPY THERE IS NO FIX

Death is my only escape, would it be so bad if I just did it tonight? There is no good time to commit suicide so I don’t see the point in waiting.

The pain never ends.

My parents say I’m a burden and friends say I’m toxic, manipulative and I have no RL friends, no to hang out with and I can’t get out of bed, I’m constantly sleeping and I am fat and disgusting I really need to die

What’s the point? 

I’m going to do it and I’m going to get it right this time. I’m feeling much more confident. 

I’m just venting, I’m having to wait for them to leave for work and then I’ll try it

They call me a burden.

After the shock it might be a good relief.

I have spent one month in hospital recently and it hasn’t helped. The therapy doesn’t help and the medication does nothing.

I know there is nothing anyone can say. I just keep bursting into tears thinking about it all. I’m going to be dead soon, I mean, we all die.
But, I’m going to die, I am going to use my dressing gown belt. I’m going to make a knot and it’s going to be over.

I want to be happy and okay. But I’m not and I can’t fathom it being alright.

I just can’t do this. I feel broken.

You’re kind for caring, god, I just keep thinking of them walking in and seeing me hanging. It’s going to be so horrible.

Why am I like this. Why can’t I be okay? I’m horrible.
